mapper.sql: a.achievement_id, a.management_no, a.teacher_user_id, u.login_id AS teacher_name, a.organization_code, a.evaluation_year, a.management_item_code, a.achievement_date, d.performance_detail, a.achievement_status, a.attachment_ref, a.created_at, a.created_by, a.updated_at, a.updated_by
FROM education_achievements a JOIN course_operation_achievement_details d ON d.achievement_id = a.achievement_id JOIN users u ON u.user_id = a.teacher_user_id
mapper.select: SELECT m.organization_code FROM organization_user_mappings m WHERE m.user_id = #{userId} AND m.status = 'ACTIVE' AND m.mapping_type = 'ORGANIZATION' AND CURRENT_DATE >= m.effective_start_date AND (m.effective_end_date IS NULL OR CURRENT_DATE <= m.effective_end_date) ORDER BY m.effective_start_date DESC, m.mapping_id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.sql: FROM evaluation_management_items m JOIN evaluation_elements e ON e.element_id = m.element_id JOIN evaluation_items i ON i.item_id = e.item_id JOIN evaluation_areas a ON a.area_id = i.area_id WHERE a.area_code = 'EDUCATION' AND a.active_yn = 'Y' AND i.active_yn = 'Y' AND e.active_yn = 'Y' AND m.active_yn = 'Y' AND m.teacher_editable_yn = 'Y'
mapper.select:
SELECT m.management_item_code, MIN(m.management_item_name) AS management_item_name
GROUP BY m.management_item_code ORDER BY m.management_item_code
mapper.update: UPDATE education_achievements SET management_item_code = #{body.managementItemCode}, achievement_date = #{body.achievementDate}, attachment_ref = #{attachments}, achievement_status = #{status}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by = #{userId} WHERE achievement_id = #{id} AND achievement_type = 'COURSE_OPERATION' AND deleted_yn = 'N' AND achievement_status IN ('DRAFT', 'DEPARTMENT_REJECTED', 'CERTIFICATION_REJECTED')
